briefings.headline: Missile Leaves 10-Meter Crater Inside Poland Near Ukraine Border
briefings.body: A missile that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described as probably Russian struck near the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, roughly 100 kilometers from the Ukrainian border, leaving a crater 10 meters wide. The strike occurred during a Russian attack on the Ukrainian city of Lviv. The object's origin remains under investigation by Polish authorities.

sources.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM

briefings.why_it_matters: A strike on Polish territory, a NATO member state, raises the specter of alliance-wide military obligations under Article 5 — with direct consequences for U.S. foreign policy and the broader course of the war in Ukraine.

briefings.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Cites Uncertain Economic Outlook
briefings.body: The Federal Reserve issued its latest FOMC statement, holding interest rates steady. The committee noted ongoing uncertainty in the economic outlook as the basis for its decision to maintain the current policy stance.
briefings.why_it_matters: Unchanged rates mean borrowing costs for mortgages, car loans, and credit cards stay at their current levels for now.

briefings.headline: Trump Eyes AI Controls After OpenAI Hacking Incidents
briefings.body: The Trump administration is considering controls on artificial intelligence following hacking incidents involving OpenAI. The move marks a shift in tone for an administration that has previously taken a hands-off approach to AI regulation.

sources.title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents

briefings.why_it_matters: A policy reversal from Washington's most AI-permissive administration could reshape the rules governing the technology millions of Americans use daily.

briefings.headline: Congress Unites Against Pentagon's Stalled PFAS Cleanup at Hundreds of Bases
briefings.body: Bipartisan anger is growing in Congress over the Pentagon's delayed cleanup of PFAS contamination at hundreds of military bases across the country. Lawmakers from both parties are demanding explanations for the slow pace of remediation. PFAS, known as forever chemicals, are linked to low birth weight and other health risks. Politicians have not yet received satisfactory answers from the Defense Department on timelines or accountability.

sources.title: Bipartisan Anger Grows at Pentagon’s Delayed ‘Forever Chemicals’ Cleanups

briefings.why_it_matters: Families living near contaminated military bases face ongoing exposure to chemicals linked to low birth weight and other serious health risks until cleanups are completed.

briefings.headline: 98 Teens Draft Their Own AI Rules for Schools After Congress Stalls
briefings.body: With no federal AI legislation for schools in place, roughly 98 teenagers convened to write their own policy framework addressing student use of AI on assignments and tests, and who should be responsible for teaching AI literacy. The student-led effort fills a vacuum left by Congress, which has not passed rules governing how artificial intelligence tools are used in K-12 education.

sources.title: Congress hasn't passed AI rules for schools. So these 98 teens did it themselves

briefings.why_it_matters: The policies governing AI in your children's classrooms are being shaped without federal guidance, leaving schools — and families — to navigate the rules largely on their own.

briefings.headline: Temple University's Inez Patterson Defied Segregated Pool Hours in 1920s Philadelphia
briefings.body: Nearly 100 years ago, Inez Patterson integrated swimming pools in Philadelphia by refusing to accept segregated swim hours at Temple University. When her white teammates swam, Patterson insisted on swimming alongside them rather than being restricted to the limited hours designated for Black swimmers. She also encouraged other Black girls to swim, expanding her individual act of defiance into a broader push for inclusion in aquatic spaces.

sources.title: Nearly 100 years ago, Philadelphia’s Inez Patterson integrated pools and encouraged other Black girls to swim too

briefings.why_it_matters: Patterson's resistance to pool segregation at Temple is an early chapter in the long fight for equal access to public recreational spaces that Black Americans continued to wage for decades after.
